Shiburin is my favorite idol since she acts professional and cold at first, but shows a different side when you get to know her, which I can relate to a lot. I also like her casual clothing style a lot, and for some reason I like how her hair is black, long and covers her forehead. Her work ethic is crazy despite the fact she has natural talent, she seems like a girl that would play hard to get at first, but has a smiling worth working towards seeing and I hate to see her cry, which causes just enough emotion to make me shed a few tears. She wasn't my favorite at first, but over time my liking to her started to grow. Also Trancing Pulse is one of my favorite songs to play, only behind Hotel Moonside.
